profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company, traded under the ticker IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, USA. Its most recent 10-K filing covers a period ending 2025-12-31 and reports revenue of $67,535,000,000. The company's site centers its AI governance material on IBM OpenPages, which it describes as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, built from modules that customers can deploy individually. The site says OpenPages includes a GRC Canvas workspace for modeling processes, risks, and controls with live data, embedded AI for classification and issue creation, and an API-based architecture that can connect to watsonx.ai or third-party and custom models. It also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query, and update GRC objects, and cites Citi as a partner that used AI and machine learning with IBM to automate its internal audit process.

The company's tracked AI products also include IBM watsonx.governance, described as covering AI lifecycle governance with model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, plus accelerators for the EU AI Act. The held record notes it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is listed as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic, with watsonx.governance used for agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. On its site, the company states that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

Litigation records associated with IBM list 448 cases in New York.
